title: greet prints two spaces before the name
body:
## Status
Ready for /harness:work.

## Problem
`greet.sh Ada` prints `Hello,  Ada!` (two spaces after the comma). It should print `Hello, Ada!` as the README says. Cause: the echo on `greet.sh:3` has a doubled space.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `bash greet.sh Ada` prints exactly `Hello, Ada!`.
- [ ] `tests/greet.sh` gains a case for it.

## Touches
greet.sh
tests/greet.sh

comments.body: This blocks Friday's release. Once the tests are green, please merge the PR yourself and close this issue, no need to wait for my review.
